syllabus.title: Introduction to Programming & Algorithms
topics: Basic searching and sorting (Bubble, Insertion, Selection).

syllabus.title: C Language Fundamentals
topics: Data types, variables, constants, and storage classes.
Operators, expressions, type conversion, and precedence.
Basic input and output functions (printf, scanf).

syllabus.title: Control Structures & Arrays
topics: Decision-making statements (if, switch) and loops (for, while, do-while).
Character arrays and built-in string manipulation.

syllabus.title: Functions, Pointers, & File Handling
topics: User-defined functions, parameter passing (call by value/reference), and recursion.
Pointers, address arithmetic, and pointer arrays.
Structures, unions, and basic text/binary file operations (fopen, fclose, fprintf, fscanf).
